confirmed_fixture_conflict: MediaEntry.charged_bytes is the retained original reservation size, not a zeroed balance. Strict entry decoder rejects zero for every state, including Removed.
MediaOp::Finalize atomically marks Removed and subtracts the retained size from catalog.bytes; it deliberately does not mutate per-entry charged_bytes.
Therefore the previous Removed && charged_bytes == 0 conjunction was impossible even when physical deletion and refund succeeded. Four later zero-size assertions had the same conflict.
